description:
An accessible, light-weight, cross-platform ebook and document reader.

Paperback is a lightweight, fast, and accessible ebook and document reader for everyone, from casual readers to heavy power users. It is designed for screen reader accessibility and a fast, bloat-free reading experience.
It reads EPUB, PDF, Word, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, RTF, HTML, Markdown, CHM, WinHelp, MOBI/Kindle, FictionBook, DAISY and comic book files, as well as M4B and MP3 audiobooks. The pb command-line tool converts documents to plain text, HTML or Markdown.
